    Hand-thrown in the Yorkshire Dales

    Make something with your hands

    Small, friendly pottery classes for complete beginners and returning makers. Wheel throwing, hand building and glazing in a calm countryside studio.

    Find your class

    Every class is kept to six people, so you get real time at the wheel and plenty of help when the clay has other ideas.

    Taster evening

    A relaxed two-hour first go on the wheel. You leave with two pieces, glazed and fired for you to collect.

    Six-week course

    One evening a week for six weeks. Centre, open, pull and trim, then glaze a set you are proud of.

    Hand building

    No wheel needed. Pinch, coil and slab your way to planters, plates and anything else you dream up.

    What our makers say

    "I had never touched clay before. By week three I was making mugs my family actually use."

    Priya, six-week course

    "The calmest Thursday evening of my week. Lovely teaching and the tea is always on."

    Tom, taster evening
